additional_considerations.rationale: Headaches may be focal but usually come with diplopia or other visual symptoms; papilledema is expected, though the exam may be normal in the first days.
Unilateral periorbital pain with ipsilateral autonomic signs, occurring in clusters and often waking patients at night; rare in women.
A rare cause of headache; she had sinusitis months ago but has no current signs or symptoms of sinus or respiratory infection.

leakage_check.reason: Family history 'mother has migraines' names the rank-1 diagnosis (migraine); legitimate history, kept as is.

source_issues: Exam e006 reads 'Heart: Respiratory rate and rhythm', evidently a mis-expansion of 'RRR' (regular rate and rhythm); recorded as regular rate and rhythm with the original wording noted (x013).
The note lists 'Medications: Ibuprofen, aspirin', but the script's medication answer (p028) is 'Ibuprofen' only; aspirin appears only as a relieving factor (p014).
Note HPI says the pain is 'sometimes accompanied by nausea and vomiting'; the script says she vomited for the first time yesterday.
p024 asks about joint pains and fatigue; the answer ('Occasional aches and pains treated with ibuprofen') does not address fatigue.
Gold #2 cites 'Chronic headaches', but the script gives a 2-week history plus one similar headache in college.
The patient name 'Kindly Clark' may be a transcription error; kept as given (the sample closure addresses 'Mrs. Clark'). The sample closure ends with a stray '[276]'.
annotator_notes: The parenthetical in p005 '(two to three times a day)' is content, not a stage direction; it is kept in f005. '(indicates the right side of the head)' in p007 is moved to persona.acting_notes.

Temporality: the episodic pattern (intermittent, frequency, per-episode severity and duration, functional limitation during episodes, nausea during pain) is 'recurrent'; the headache present now (p012) is 'current'.
Tubal ligation from p030 and p038 combined into one fact (f044); p038's denial of birth-control pills is a separate fact (f053).
Following the worked example, the sp_notes direction 'look as if you are in severe pain' is kept as an acting note only; the note exam (x001) already records severe pain.
The patient description 'married with three children' exists only in raw_opening; kept in persona.acting_notes (p036 also gives husband and three children).
